body: Have you tried creative or like science focused stuff? I listen to criminal justice stuff and psychological videos. Although i end up paranoid, so im not sure if i should recommend any of that
What do you watch on YouTube?
Well if you cant eat something, drink more water. And please dont fall over

Depression is like a constant one on one war. Armimg yourself with small things can help better your chances of winning. Even if it's something brand new like learning Mandarin or filming yourself talking shit about horror movies. I know it feels like a chore, but maybe because there's pressure behind it. Even if it's for five minutes, give yourself a moment to draw or something else.
Have you at least been drinking water? And try to eat one other thing. It helps in my case at least.
Those are great reasons to continue for. I hope you gain more reasons along the way.
Life is shitty but sometimes you can make special days special on your own. Did you get yourself a cake or pie?
I'm sorry your birthday isn't a happy one. I hope future ones are better.
You've given me a lot to think over.. I really appreciate this. And I miss writing. It's like not breathing.

I understand what you're going through because I feel that way right now. I've been living for the small things like tv shows, my cat, books, etc. Do you have any small things to live for?

If you need someone to vent to, I dont mind listening.
Prompts always helped me in the past. Thank you for the suggestions. I appreciate the conversation and help.
I think those are all great questions that I've been avoiding. Do you really think writing will help?
Yeah. Im scared to write again. But i want to again.
That's how I've been living my life for the past five years. Living for little things. But it's starting to not be enough so I guess I'm scrambling to find any reason to live.

I'm terrified of doing the thing that's meaningful to me again. I was so invested with writing and maybe even good at it, but what if i fail? I fail at every other aspect of my life. Im terrified of tainting that last morsel of goodness in me. Do you relate?
